name: wireframe-picker
description: Turn a UI decision into real shadcn-composed variants, screenshotted and chosen by clicking instead of describing a preference in words.

interface.shortDescription: Pick a UI direction by clicking screenshots, not describing them.
interface.longDescription: Propose a few shadcn-composed variants as text, build the confirmed ones in parallel isolated worktrees, screenshot each with Playwright, and let the human choose by clicking a screenshot in their own browser. Reads the click back on the next turn and merges the winning worktree.
capabilities: Draft cheap text variant specs before rendering anything
Build confirmed variants in parallel isolated git worktrees
Render real shadcn component compositions per variant
Serve a click-to-choose picker screen in the user's own browser
Read the chosen variant back from recorded click events
Merge the winning worktree and discard the rest
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $wireframe-picker to propose a few shadcn-composed variants for this UI decision, confirm which to render, build each in its own worktree, screenshot them, and let me pick by clicking instead of reading a description.
